ordering: Commit before implementation, tests, and target scoring; keep failure cases and do not tune after inspected results without a new protocol.
question: Can a public-outcome learner detect reversal and reversion in the same unchanging sensor schema using predictive evidence, without explicit regime labels, manual change-point hints, or using held-out test outcomes to fit?
dynamics: Use existing authored basin two-variable max-minus-min band mechanics. A: original progress/damage labels. B: swap progress and damage, same feature keys inlet/outlet, same action identifiers and public schema, identical hidden per-seed band. Return A: original rules again. This is NOT independent generalization or a naturally arising real-world shift.
simulation: One independent random first-action simulator actor per disposable train episode. All observed samples have identical feature key signatures; no phase name, world field, hidden range band, episode index or simulator state allowed in learner memory.

candidate.original: Frozen source archive learned from first 192 events, as a manually chosen source-anchoring prior. Remaining 48 original training observations also stay in memory.
candidate.recent: Last 12 feedback events excluding latest 4 evaluation events (a rolling window trained on data disjoint from scoring events), when total event count >=208. Candidate is initially contaminated after a shift.
candidate.scoring: Sum smoothed class log-likelihood over last 4 feedback events; original vs recent, tie favors original. Same feature set for all events; this method never receives a stage label.
candidate.abstention: If the selected candidate's mean feedback log likelihood is worse than -1.5, abstain from the read-only proposed TEST action; an abstention is a failed task and is not counted as success. May miss damaging switches if evidence sparse.
candidate.training: Scores and candidate models are reconstructed strictly from append-only public examples, checkpointed and validated by SHA256 record, no deletion or promoted default.

acceptance: An adaptive method should improve over frozen_A/cumulative in reversed B by 16/24 observations while recovering original A by 4/8/16 observations. Compare recent-eight and recent-32; preserve misses, abstentions and possible negative transfer. No full success claim based on abstaining.
hard_limits: No hidden phase or physics provided to model
Do not interpret one rule reversal as full generalization
Simulated source feedback can be forged, sha digest does not authenticate
No default controller promotion or merge
No real-world actuation or AthenZ/Synveil integration
